NKJV.1: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, who went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
NKJV.2: Now Moses wrote down the starting points of their journeys at the command of the LORD. And these are their journeys according to their starting points:
NKJV.3: They departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the day after the Passover the children of Israel went out with boldness in the sight of all the Egyptians.
NKJV.4: For the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had killed among them. Also on their gods the LORD had executed judgments.
NKJV.5: Then the children of Israel moved from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
NKJV.6: They departed from Succoth and camped at Etham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.
NKJV.7: They moved from Etham and turned back to Pi Hahiroth, which is east of Baal Zephon; and they camped near Migdol.
NKJV.8: They departed from before Hahiroth and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, went three days’ journey in the Wilderness of Etham, and camped at Marah.
NKJV.9: They moved from Marah and came to Elim. At Elim were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees; so they camped there.
NKJV.10: They moved from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
NKJV.11: They moved from the Red Sea and camped in the Wilderness of Sin.
NKJV.12: They journeyed from the Wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
NKJV.13: They departed from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
NKJV.14: They moved from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
NKJV.15: They departed from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.
NKJV.16: They moved from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth Hattaavah.
NKJV.17: They departed from Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
NKJV.18: They departed from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
NKJV.19: They departed from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perez.
NKJV.20: They departed from Rimmon Perez and camped at Libnah.
NKJV.21: They moved from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
NKJV.22: They journeyed from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
NKJV.23: They went from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
NKJV.24: They moved from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
NKJV.25: They moved from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
NKJV.26: They moved from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
NKJV.27: They departed from Tahath and camped at Terah.
NKJV.28: They moved from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
NKJV.29: They went from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
NKJV.30: They departed from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
NKJV.31: They departed from Moseroth and camped at Bene Jaakan.
NKJV.32: They moved from Bene Jaakan and camped at Hor Hagidgad.
NKJV.33: They went from Hor Hagidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
NKJV.34: They moved from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
NKJV.35: They departed from Abronah and camped at Ezion Geber.
NKJV.36: They moved from Ezion Geber and camped in the Wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
NKJV.37: They moved from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the boundary of the land of Edom.
NKJV.38: Then Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor at the command of the LORD, and died there in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.
NKJV.39: Aaron was one hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.
NKJV.40: Now the king of Arad, the Canaanite, who dwelt in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
NKJV.41: So they departed from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
NKJV.42: They departed from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
NKJV.43: They departed from Punon and camped at Oboth.
NKJV.44: They departed from Oboth and camped at Ije Abarim, at the border of Moab.
NKJV.45: They departed from Ijim and camped at Dibon Gad.
NKJV.46: They moved from Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.
NKJV.47: They moved from Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
NKJV.48: They departed from the mountains of Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.
NKJV.49: They camped by the Jordan, from Beth Jesimoth as far as the Abel Acacia Grove in the plains of Moab.
NKJV.50: Now the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho, saying,
NKJV.51: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When you have crossed the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
NKJV.52: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their engraved stones, destroy all their molded images, and demolish all their high places;
NKJV.53: you shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land and dwell in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
NKJV.54: And you shall divide the land by lot as an inheritance among your families; to the larger you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance; there everyone’s inheritance shall be whatever falls to him by lot. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
NKJV.55: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then it shall be that those whom you let remain shall be irritants in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they shall harass you in the land where you dwell.
NKJV.56: Moreover it shall be that I will do to you as I thought to do to them.’ ”

NASB.37: They journeyed from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, at the edge of the land of Edom.
NASB.38: Then Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor at the command of the LORD, and died there in the fortieth year after the sons of Israel had come from the land of Egypt, on the first [day] in the fifth month.

ESV.3: They set out from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the Passover, the people of Israel went out triumphantly in the sight of all the Egyptians,
ESV.4: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them. On their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
ESV.5: So the people of Israel set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
ESV.6: And they set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.
ESV.7: And they set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which is east of Baal-zephon, and they camped before Migdol.
ESV.8: And they set out from before Hahiroth  and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and they went a three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
ESV.9: And they set out from Marah and came to Elim; at Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
ESV.10: And they set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
ESV.11: And they set out from the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
ESV.12: And they set out from the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
ESV.13: And they set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
ESV.14: And they set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
ESV.15: And they set out from Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.
ESV.16: And they set out from the wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
ESV.17: And they set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
ESV.18: And they set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
ESV.19: And they set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
ESV.20: And they set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
ESV.21: And they set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
ESV.22: And they set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
ESV.23: And they set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
ESV.24: And they set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
ESV.25: And they set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
ESV.26: And they set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
ESV.27: And they set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.
ESV.28: And they set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
ESV.29: And they set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
ESV.30: And they set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
ESV.31: And they set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
ESV.32: And they set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
ESV.33: And they set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
ESV.34: And they set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
ESV.35: And they set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
ESV.36: And they set out from Ezion-geber and camped in the wilderness of Zin (that is, Kadesh).
ESV.37: And they set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Edom.
ESV.38: And Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor at the command of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the people of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.
ESV.39: And Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor.
ESV.40: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the Negeb in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the people of Israel.
ESV.41: And they set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
ESV.42: And they set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
ESV.43: And they set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
ESV.44: And they set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, in the territory of Moab.
ESV.45: And they set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
ESV.46: And they set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
ESV.47: And they set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
ESV.48: And they set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho;
ESV.49: they camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
ESV.50: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
ESV.51: “Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
ESV.52: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you and destroy all their figured stones and destroy all their metal images and demolish all their high places.
ESV.53: And you shall take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given the land to you to possess it.
ESV.54: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your clans. To a large tribe you shall give a large inheritance, and to a small tribe you shall give a small inheritance. Wherever the lot falls for anyone, that shall be his. According to the tribes of your fathers you shall inherit.
ESV.55: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those of them whom you let remain shall be as barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they shall trouble you in the land where you dwell.
ESV.56: And I will do to you as I thought to do to them.”

NLT.1: This is the route the Israelites followed as they marched out of Egypt under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
NLT.2: At the LORD’s direction, Moses kept a written record of their progress. These are the stages of their march, identified by the different places where they stopped along the way.
NLT.3: They set out from the city of Rameses in early spring — on the fifteenth day of the first month — on the morning after the first Passover celebration. The people of Israel left defiantly, in full view of all the Egyptians.
NLT.4: Meanwhile, the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn sons, whom the LORD had killed the night before. The LORD had defeated the gods of Egypt that night with great acts of judgment!
NLT.5: After leaving Rameses, the Israelites set up camp at Succoth.
NLT.6: Then they left Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the wilderness.
NLT.7: They left Etham and turned back toward Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon, and camped near Migdol.
NLT.8: They left Pi-hahiroth and crossed the Red Sea into the wilderness beyond. Then they traveled for three days into the Etham wilderness and camped at Marah.
NLT.9: They left Marah and camped at Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees.
NLT.10: They left Elim and camped beside the Red Sea.
NLT.11: They left the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
NLT.12: They left the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
NLT.13: They left Dophkah and camped at Alush.
NLT.14: They left Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
NLT.15: They left Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.
NLT.16: They left the wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
NLT.17: They left Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
NLT.18: They left Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
NLT.19: They left Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
NLT.20: They left Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
NLT.21: They left Libnah and camped at Rissah.
NLT.22: They left Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
NLT.23: They left Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
NLT.24: They left Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
NLT.25: They left Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
NLT.26: They left Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
NLT.27: They left Tahath and camped at Terah.
NLT.28: They left Terah and camped at Mithcah.
NLT.29: They left Mithcah and camped at Hashmonah.
NLT.30: They left Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
NLT.31: They left Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
NLT.32: They left Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
NLT.33: They left Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
NLT.34: They left Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
NLT.35: They left Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
NLT.36: They left Ezion-geber and camped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
NLT.37: They left Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, at the border of Edom.
NLT.38: While they were at the foot of Mount Hor, Aaron the priest was directed by the LORD to go up the mountain, and there he died. This happened in midsummer, on the first day of the fifth month of the fortieth year after Israel’s departure from Egypt.
NLT.39: Aaron was 123 years old when he died there on Mount Hor.
NLT.40: At that time the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard that the people of Israel were approaching his land.
NLT.41: Meanwhile, the Israelites left Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
NLT.42: Then they left Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
NLT.43: They left Punon and camped at Oboth.
NLT.44: They left Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab.
NLT.45: They left Iye-abarim and camped at Dibon-gad.
NLT.46: They left Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
NLT.47: They left Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains east of the river, near Mount Nebo.
NLT.48: They left the mountains east of the river and camped on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho.
NLT.49: Along the Jordan River they camped from Beth-jeshimoth as far as the meadows of Acacia on the plains of Moab.
NLT.50: While they were camped near the Jordan River on the plains of Moab opposite Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.51: “Give the following instructions to the people of Israel: When you cross the Jordan River into the land of Canaan,
NLT.52: you must drive out all the people living there. You must destroy all their carved and molten images and demolish all their pagan shrines.
NLT.53: Take possession of the land and settle in it, because I have given it to you to occupy.
NLT.54: You must distribute the land among the clans by sacred lot and in proportion to their size. A larger portion of land will be allotted to each of the larger clans, and a smaller portion will be allotted to each of the smaller clans. The decision of the sacred lot is final. In this way, the portions of land will be divided among your ancestral tribes.
NLT.55: But if you fail to drive out the people who live in the land, those who remain will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land where you live.
NLT.56: And I will do to you what I had planned to do to them.”

WEB.1: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
WEB.2: Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their goings out.
WEB.3: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
WEB.4: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.

WEB.6: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
WEB.7: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.

WEB.10: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
WEB.11: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
WEB.12: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
WEB.13: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
WEB.14: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
WEB.15: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
WEB.16: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
WEB.17: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
WEB.18: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
WEB.19: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
WEB.20: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
WEB.21: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
WEB.22: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
WEB.23: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
WEB.24: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
WEB.25: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
WEB.26: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
WEB.27: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
WEB.28: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
WEB.29: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
WEB.30: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
WEB.31: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
WEB.32: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
WEB.33: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
WEB.34: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
WEB.35: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
WEB.36: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
WEB.37: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
WEB.38: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

WEB.40: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

WEB.42: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

WEB.49: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

AMP.1: These are the stages of the journeys of the Israelites, by which they came out of the land of Egypt by their [tribal] armies, under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
AMP.2: Moses recorded their points of departure, as the LORD commanded, stage by stage; and these are their journeys according to their points of departure:
AMP.3: They set out from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the day after the Passover the Israelites moved out triumphantly in the sight of all the Egyptians,
AMP.4: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn whom the LORD had struck down among them. Upon their gods the LORD also executed judgments.
AMP.5: Then the Israelites moved out from Rameses [where they had all joined together], and camped in Succoth.
AMP.6: They moved out from Succoth and camped in Etham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.
AMP.7: They moved out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, east of Baal-zephon, and they camped before Migdol.
AMP.8: They moved out from before Pi-hahiroth and passed through the midst of the [Red] Sea into the wilderness; and they went a three days' journey in the Wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
AMP.9: They moved out from Marah and came to Elim; in Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
AMP.10: They moved out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea (Sea of Reeds).
AMP.11: They moved out from the Red Sea and camped in the Wilderness of Sin.
AMP.12: They moved out from the Wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
AMP.13: They moved out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
AMP.14: They moved out from Alush and camped at Rephidim; now it was there that the people had no water to drink.
AMP.15: They moved out from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai [where they remained for about a year].
AMP.16: They moved out from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
AMP.17: They moved out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
AMP.18: They moved out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah [near Kadesh, the place from which the twelve spies were sent to spy out the land of Canaan].
AMP.19: They moved out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
AMP.20: They moved out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
AMP.21: They moved out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
AMP.22: They moved out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
AMP.23: They moved out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
AMP.24: They moved out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
AMP.25: They moved out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
AMP.26: They moved out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
AMP.27: They moved out from Tahath and camped at Terah.
AMP.28: They moved out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
AMP.29: They moved out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
AMP.30: They moved out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
AMP.31: They moved out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
AMP.32: They moved out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
AMP.33: They moved out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
AMP.34: They moved out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
AMP.35: They moved out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber [or Elath on the gulf of Aqabah].
AMP.36: They moved out from Ezion-geber and camped in the Wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
AMP.37: They moved out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Edom.
AMP.38: Aaron the priest went up on Mount Hor at the command of the LORD, and died there in the fortieth year after the Israelites came out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.
AMP.39: Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.
AMP.40: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev (the South country) in the land of Canaan, heard that the sons of Israel were coming.
AMP.41: They moved out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
AMP.42: Then they moved out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
AMP.43: They moved out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
AMP.44: They moved out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, on the border of Moab.

NIV.28: They left Terah and camped at Mithcah.
NIV.29: They left Mithcah and camped at Hashmonah.
NIV.30: They left Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
NIV.31: They left Moseroth and camped at Bene Jaakan.

NIV.42: They left Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
NIV.43: They left Punon and camped at Oboth.
NIV.44: They left Oboth and camped at Iye Abarim, on the border of Moab.
NIV.45: They left Iyim and camped at Dibon Gad.
NIV.46: They left Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.
NIV.47: They left Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, near Nebo.

NIV.51: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,
NIV.52: drive out all the inhabitants of the land before you. Destroy all their carved images and their cast idols, and demolish all their high places.
